But a servant with divided loyalties is no servant at all.|Back cover blurb|}} '''''Thrawn: Treason''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. Published on [[July 23]], [[2019]] by [[Del Rey]], it acts as the sequel to the [[2018]] novel ''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]'', as well as the final installment in ''[[Star Wars: The Imperial Trilogy]]''. Set before the [[Family Reunion – and Farewell|finale]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', ''Thrawn: Treason'' features [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] crossing paths with [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Krennic]] as well as the return of [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]]. Chronologically, ''Thrawn: Treason'' is set between the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episodes "[[Rebel Assault]]" and "[[Family Reunion – and Farewell]]."
